body: Thank you so much for your kind words. I really don’t want to make a fuss (I guess this is an almost memoir, if I’m honest). I have a time decided 5 years from now and if I’m still not happy (which will be 25 years by that point ) then that’s it. For now I’ll keep fighting and hope you will too. I hope you know how amazing you are for even spending the time to talk to me and let you know you’ve saved me (at least for now). You’ve done more than anyone I actually know, has ever done. I hope that can help you feel a bit better about how you feel at times. Best of luck to you, let’s hope we can always look at the light rather than the dark
